name: creatify-ad-agent
description: Create and revise video ads with Creatify's Ad Agent.

interface.longDescription: Create video ads from a product brief and reference media. Review generated footage, adjust shots, captions, music and calls to action, then export a finished take through Creatify. A Creatify account and available credits are required for generation and shipping.
defaultPrompt: Make a 15-second video ad for my product
Create a video ad from these reference clips
Resume my latest Creatify Ad Agent project
